title: Robust stochastic first order methods in heavy-tailed noise via medoid mini-batch gradient sampling
abstract: arXiv:2605.07634v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider a first order stochastic optimization framework where, at each iteration, $K$ independent identically distributed (i.i.d.) data point samples are drawn, based on which stochastic gradients can be queried. We allow gradient noise to be heavy-tailed, with possibly infinite variances. For the considered heavy-tailed setting, many algorithmic variants have recently been proposed based on gradient clipping or other nonlinear operators (e.g., normalization) applied over noisy gradients. In this paper, we take an alternative approach and propose a novel gradient estimator. The core idea of proposed estimator is to split the $K$-sized data batch into $M$ distinct data chunks, form for each chunk the stochastic gradient, and select the stochastic gradient of the chunk that is medoid of gradients of all data-chunks. translated_title: 通过中心元小批量梯度采样实现重尾噪声下鲁棒的随机一阶方法
translated_abstract: 我们考虑一个一阶随机优化框架，其中在每次迭代中抽取K个独立同分布（i.i.d.）的数据点样本，基于这些样本可以查询随机梯度。我们允许梯度噪声呈重尾分布，方差可能为无限。针对所考虑的重尾设置，最近已提出了许多算法变体，它们基于梯度裁剪或对噪声梯度应用其他非线性算子（例如归一化）。在本文中，我们采取一种替代方法，提出了一种新颖的梯度估计器。所提估计器的核心思想是将大小为K的数据批次分割成M个不同的数据块，为每个数据块形成随机梯度，然后选取作为所有数据块梯度中心元的那个数据块的随机梯度。对于一大类对称重尾梯度噪声分布，我们证明了所提出的估计器具……
tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的梯度估计器，通过将小批量数据分割成多个数据块并选取梯度中心元作为估计值，在无需梯度裁剪等非线性操作的情况下，实现了重尾噪声（方差可能无限）下鲁棒的随机一阶优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel gradient estimator that splits the mini-batch into multiple chunks and selects the medoid chunk gradient, achieving robust stochastic first-order optimization under heavy-tailed noise with possibly infinite variance, without resorting to gradient clipping or other nonlinear operators.
